phrases.definition: the remaining part of something or the others in a group
phrases.example: Daryl took a few bites of the cake and then gave the rest of it to his little sister.

phrases.definition: being physically present somewhere
phrases.example: Deborah decided to visit the museum in person to see the paintings instead of looking at them online.

phrases.definition: to consider someone or something to be important and worthy of attention
phrases.example: Archie loves making fun of people, so don't take his words seriously.

phrases.definition: to fail to meet someone's expectations or keep a promise that you made
phrases.example: Roy promised his daughter that he would attend her school play, and he didn't let her down.

phrases.definition: to check something and be certain about it
phrases.example: Please make sure that you don't go over the speed limit when you are driving.

phrases.definition: to regard someone or something as the most important thing
phrases.example: Most parents put their children's needs first and want them to be happy and healthy.

phrases.definition: to wear a special costume or special clothes, usually for a special occasion
phrases.example: Every Halloween, the young cousins dress up as their favorite cartoon characters.

phrases.definition: used to emphasize that something is true
phrases.example: December is not cold in Australia. In fact, it's the middle of summer.

phrases.definition: to search through or look at several things one by one
phrases.example: Bill is going through the list of winners to see if he is one of them.

phrases.definition: done with knowledge of the possibility that something might have happened or will happen
phrases.example: Each of the hikers brought an umbrella and a raincoat in case it rained.

phrases.definition: also
phrases.example: Please remember to bring a snack to the party. In addition, you should bring a gift for the birthday boy.

phrases.definition: to spend time together in a fun or casual way
phrases.example: Alice and her friends always hang out in a café after school on Fridays.

phrases.definition: to go to or rely on someone or something for some purpose
phrases.example: Tracy always turns to her older sister Ivy when she has a problem with one of her friends.

phrases.meaning: 認為……是針對個人；對……感到不悅
phrases.definition: to be offended by something
phrases.example: Please don't take this personally, but I don't like your shirt. You look better in darker colors.
